acf.intro_presentazione:
Andrea Ruggeri
A.K.A. Rugge.
33 years old
Italian, living in Asola (MN).
acf.descrizione_contenuto:
Hey, I’m Andrea Ruggeri.
I apologize for what you’ll read, but i’m not so used to get an intro of myself. My background is in UI Design and Development.
Essentially i’m in love with everything related to web design.

In the last six years I’ve found my path: helping visionary brands flourish.
I currently work at Beconcept, a creative agency that aims to achieve tangible results for its clients as they make their way through the digitization process.

I’m also deeply passionate about artificial intelligence.
I regularly host workshops exploring how this technology is reshaping our lives, work, and creative processes.
Regarding AI, I created AI Journal, a weekly 5-minute podcast where I share updates and insights on the evolving world of tech, with a special focus on AI.

Before that, I co-founded KPI6.
KPI6 is where i started my adventure in the digital world.
As Head of product I learnt how to grow a business from scratch.

In my free time i immerse myself in the world of gastronomy and artisanal wines, enjoying the conviviality of a classic osteria with friends. Photography is another personal pursuit that accompanies most of these experiences.

I live with Giulia in Asola, a small (and beauty) city in the north of Italy.

You can fine me on various platforms like:

Linkedin, Instagram, Cosmos.
